newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to inject reserves into the banking system on Wednesday through overnight system repurchase agreements, analysts said.

With this session the final day of the two-week maintenance period, a quarterly corporate tax payment day and a seven-year note maturity, federal funds are seen trading firm, which should push the Fed to add reserves, analysts said.
Indeed, federal funds opened at 5-1/2 percent, well above the 5-1/4 percent target rate.
The Fed executed overnight system RPs totalling just $1.0 billion on Tuesday. Analysts said they expected a larger $3.0 billion operation this session.
Both 3-day and 10-day system RPs remain outstanding.
In the new reserve period beginning Thursday, analysts projected a an average daily add need of about $3.5 billion.
